nom: TONYMOLY I'm Rice Active Enzyme Exfoliating Cleanser

avis.texte: I preface that I am 44. I have fairly sensitive combination skin that can get extremely oily in my t-zone but extremely dry on my cheeks and outer forehead. My skin is getting more dry and flaky as I age. I was looking for a gentle chemical exfoliator with a bit of fine mechanical polishing that wasn't extremely expensive. This really checks the boxes for me. The powder, when mixed with a splash of water, transformers to a foam with almost no grit. I first apply a warm wash cloth across my face for about 5 minutes to prep and humidify my face. Then I gently massage the foamy cleanser on my face, rinse, and repeat. I only use it once a week to help remove just the excess buildup of dead skin. It makes my skin so smooth. I finish with one of my favorite nighttime moisturizers. Yes, the bottle comes half full but it's still a lot of product AND it allows for control when dispensing the powder. It's still cheaper than the Tatcha The Rice Polish Deep (the only Tatcha Rice Polish with fruit/papaya enzyme). I have tried a sample of that. This Tonymoly version is extremely similar. The powder itself is a little more gritty but once water is added, the consistency of the foam is the same. I want to mention that I have a severe allergy to latex. Therefore, I can have a cross-sensitivity to products that contain papaya. Thankfully, I have not had a reaction with this product. That usually means that the Papaya Enzyme (Papain) is extremely refined. I also did not have a reaction to the T

avis.titre: Cheaper version of a. more expensive brand.
avis.texte: I was trained under a higher end brand while in aesthetic school. I continue to buy the higher and brand for my personal use. It was quite expensive, so I decided to do a little research to see if I can find a brand that could rival do more expensive brand. I purchased this one and it lived up to the hype. I have since ditched my higher end brand and use this brand exclusively. This is going on my third year!
Hands down the best exfoliate cleanser with 100 percent clean ingredients. I've been using it for years.
I have used many powdered cleansers in all price ranges. This one is great. Removes sunscreen well, exfoliates gently, and is scent free. Will forever buy.

I love this exfoliating cleanser so much! It has really healthy, clean, non-toxic ingredients, and it leaves my skin feeling fresh and smooth. I also love that it comes in a powder form! It makes it fun, and it's super easy to use! My only wish is that Ulta would carry it in stores again instead of online only. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a gentle exfoliating cleanser. At least try it once! ✨

avis.titre: Excellent for normal to oil skin
avis.texte: Cleans face really well, even without another cleanser. Works well for oily skin.

Sooo despite what the product images are showing, you definitely don't need to use THAT much product lol I use a quarter sized amount in my palm, pour about half of that in my palms (for even distributing), and that's plenty for my entire face. When used on a wet face and with a couple drops of water, this turns from the most gentle exfoliate into a rich lather. It is a relatively deep clean as it does somewhat dry out areas of my face that don't usually. But with a good moisturizer, it's a dream. Really hope they don't change the formula and continue making it. The effects and price are just too good compared to other products.

I have been using at night. it's a little bit scrubby at first so takes off makeup but does not leave skin feeling stripped and dry. a bottle lasts for a long time. only drawback: dispenser gets clogged, easily fixed by poking with clean scissors. Reading other reviews and I agree it is similar to demalogica microexfoliant but more soapy or sudsy so removes makeup better
Great for my sensitive skin, not to abrasive. I love the feel of my skin after using this product

avis.titre: Not as good as P&L, Dermalogica, or Tatcha
avis.texte: I've compared this side-by-side with Tir Tir & Dermalogica and this one is less effective and more coarse. For the price, it does the job, but the Tir Tir is about the same price (slightly more product for a slightly higher price). I've also tried the Tatcha & Dermalogica as samples and this will do, but the experience leaves much to be desired. Also I use this for KP and it's not as effective at cleaning out my pores as the others. Only pro is this one is easier to pour out the bottle, as the powder is so coarse it doesn't stick together.

i have genuinely the most sensitive skin ever...like 4 month old baby that keeps getting ezcema breakouts level sensitive. this exfoliator is the BEST I AM SO SERIOUS. no redness, no patchy spots, just smooth skin. i would def recommend moisturizing as soon as youve dried your face though!

avis.titre: Dry skin/ Not so sensitive/ 1x a Week Usage Review
avis.texte: Soooo i did NOT like it AT ALL. At first since i was barely figuring out what worked for me, i couldn't believe it was a "gentle exfoliator" but idk what it was in there but it deff broke me out every time i used it.

avis.titre: Yes!! I love how this product leaves my face every night.
avis.texte: I love using it with cold water. Makes it feel refreshing and smooth after using a different product before it.
I have sensitive skin, so strong products such as exfoliators ruin my skin. But this product gently exfoliates and cleanses well.

I personally bought this after watching videos about rice in skin care and for the price I went for the buy. It's interesting for sure with the rice powder and it doesn't become a cleanser until you add a little bit of water. I found little drops of water and then rubbing them together till they sud makes the cleanser every fun and lightweight. There's no scent and after using for a few weeks I can visible see a different in my skin. The exfoliation is very gentle.

avis.titre: MAJOR DUPE FOR THE DERMALOGICA EXFOLIATOR CLEANSER
avis.texte: This product is really good! Especially for the price such a win. I use this for my PM skin care routine and it genuinely feels as good if not better than the Daily Microfoliant Refillable Exfoliator. I have textured/ dry skin so this definitely helps it feel a lot smoother. Such a WIN!

I dont understand how this powder wash isnt rated higher? The bottle lasted me a year. I dont use it daily because it does have papain enzymes for a grntle non physical exfoliant. Its scent is not perfumed, its a natirally occuring scent of the enzymes and rice, almost a weird milk like scent. I would compare thid to Dermalogica Milk foliant but I think this is better, and of course better priced. This brand Tony Moly is underrated. Im not a fan of most Korean skin stuff but this wash is great. My combo mature skin loved it.

Convert! One day I thought to compare ingredients. TONYMOLY has FAR less chemicals and ingredients. I've been using Dermalogica's for over 20 years. I tried others. Tatcha is great, Shisedo too. I's so happy I thought to look!

Since similar product was discontinued by another brand I'd been using, happened upon this one in store and glad I got it. It's just as good and less expensive. At age 62 I still have oily skin and after washing with this powder cleanser my face feels clean but not stripped.

You only need to add about a dime size of this powder to the palm of your hand and add a few drops of warm water and it froths up into the most decadent foamy cleanser. It feels silky smooth washing your face with this and leaves the skin feeling so soft. Its not a harsh physical exfoliant. I'm so glad I bought it, and will continue to repurchase. I use it one to two times per week, depending on what my skin needs.

I purchased this July 2023. I was using it about 2-3 times a week and I noticed that i was breaking out. I stopped using it in September 2023 and my face cleared up by October 2023. I used it again on December 2023 and my face broke out. I used it again February 2024 and again, I broke out. Some of the pros, it's super easy to use. My face did feel very clean after using it. Cons: the bottle was half empty, it made me breakout every time. It's affordable and I'm sure it works for a lot of people, it just didnt work for me. Side note: My skin is more on the dry side. I really wanted to love it.
i love this product! it's so gentle and moisturizing, yet exfoliates!
Purchased as an afforable dupe to the peach & lily rice enzyme cleanser but its not worth it. Bottle is 3/4 full, and I did order pick up so I didnt notice beforehand.
It's not too stripping. It feels clean and brightens as well.

avis.titre: Wish I knew about this earlier!
avis.texte: 5 stars if it mixed better but once you figure out the water to powder ratio it's an incredible foaming, effective but gentle exfoliator! I wash first then use this with a silicone nub brush. Skin is soft, brighter, less blackheads. Little goes long way.
I had very much trouble with my chin blackheads and nothing helped. One face wash with this enzyme powder and i was shocked. I never believed the reviews but it worked so well. Definetly recommend.

I love this product. It's a solid, gentle, everyday scrub. I use it in the morning to prep my skin for the day. Its a dupe of more expensive brands like dermalogica. Its k beauty and good quality. I recommend it.

Its very effective and last forever i bought my second bottle a while ago and its still going strong. I really like that it's not super rough as i have sensitive skin but still does what i need it to do! Highly recommend
This is a good, scent-free gently exfoliating skin cleanser that does what it is created to do. It's not quite as effective as the more expensive Humanrace brand, but it works.

I enjoyed using this product but it cause tiny pimples the day after using it. I have very sensitive skin so this must have not agreed with me. I thought thus was really gentle and if it worked for me I would have bought it again.
This works great on my combo skin. Cleanses well, and makes my face feel really smooth. Does not irritate at all.

I found this product after searching the internet for a Tatcha Rice Powder dupe and I am so inpressed! It is very gentle, works instantly, and safe for everyday use. HOWEVER, the bottle, completely sealed and unopened, was only filled barely over 50%. If this product were any higher than $14, I'd be livid about that.

this product I bought myself, and I really like it! it's gentle, but removes all dead skin from face and leave polish feeling, no fragrance, and it will last you long time, I recommend for purchasing.

avis.titre: I really like the product. I makes my skin glow.
avis.texte: I would definitely recommend this to anyone who has sensitive skin. It's really gentle and tones down my redness. The only issue I have with this product is the fact that because it's made of a dry powder consistency, it will sometimes get into the corners of my eyes and I'll have to flush it out. For that reason I usually tend to use it in the shower only. Still like it. Wish there was a liquid version. I do really like TONYMOLY's skincare line overall.

avis.titre: I tried it for a month
avis.texte: The results just werent what i expected for it claiming to exfoliate. I nornally have oily combination skin and I feel like this dried that out, it at first made my skin soft, but then dried my skin out with continued use and hasnt fixed the texture my skin has accumulated on one cheek; that being the opposite i sleep on. I use a cleanser everyday when I shower and this was just not suitable even with cold water it left my skin clean but overly dry feeling the need for immexiate moisturizer for the past few weeks. I even used a tony moly moisturizer but it still did this to my skin type. I just loved the packaging and products by TM mostly, im sure it works great for very oily skin types!

This is a nice, gentle exfoliating cleanser. It feels like it really cleans out my pores without making my face feeling stripped. I only gave it 4 stars bc I think baking soda would give you the same effects
Very good exfolient with no smell. The natural smell it has os probably the enzymes. This doest dry out my combo skin like Dermalogica does! Leaves my combo mature skin feeling soft and clean.
I like this. it reminds of the tatcha rice polish. but it was literally only half way full. why am I paying full price for a product thats only half way full? I'm actually pretty mad about it.

I love this product! it doesn't have an obnoxious smell and it leaves my skin feeling so soft! I use it 2-3x's a week, and the bottle is going to last a long time as you don't need much at all! I see some complaints from others about their bottles being half empty.... of course it's going to be as it's not liquid. if they filled the bottle completely that would weigh more than the 1.76oz as advertised. No one is getting 'ripped off'. This is a great purchase!

Looking for alternative powder exfoliants or dupes for dermalogica daily microexfoliant (pricey!) has been a challenge. I have oily acne prone skin and sometimes i need a gentle exfoliant that won't disrupt my skin and can be incorporated to my regular skincare routine — this powder goes a long way. What i like is that you can adjust the level of grit to your liking, who knew rice could be so skin friendly! It's gentle for everyday , helps with oil & sebum , can be mixed with gel cleansers and is priced at 1/5 of the dermalogica price

avis.titre: Perfect for my sensitive combination mature skin
avis.texte: This exfoliating is good, I have mature sensitive combination skin with large pores, and I use this 3X a week, it cleans, and brightens my skin, leaving it ready for the rest of my skincare routine. I also use it on my very sensitive armpits 2xwk, because I used to have little bumps and roughness in that area so I thought if this product is good for my sensitive face it may also work for my armpits, and it did! After just 2 uses my armpits are now soft, with no roughness and the skin is clearing up.
I usually buy the dermatologica microfoliant cleanser, I found this, while looking into korean skin care and it's just as good and affordable.
Forever purchasing! Skin is smooth, clean, & hydrated every time! Love it < 3

i've been using this for about a month, and i have combination skin, so an oily nose for the most part. but the nostrils of my nose do tend to get flaky, and using this product has really helped exfoliate my nose where i need it. i use it all over, but its very gentle and its foamy and scent free :) i would recommend if you need something gentle and if you're looking to cleanse AND exfoliate

I love this gentle face scrub. I have sensitive skin that hates glycolic acid and anything harsh. This is enough to brighten my complexion and to make it feel really clean. I use a few times a week for soft skin free from breakouts or irritation. My husband also started borrowing it. And still does. He's not into skincare, but really likes this product! I dont mind- he looks better for it. 😂

avis.titre: Nice exfoliator for when you need it
avis.texte: I use this exfoliator about 1-2 times a week, its gentle and doesn't damage your skin barrier. Make sure to put water on both your hands and your face before use though.

I love this cleanser. My favorite thing about it is that it's great for traveling. It's small and light, and if I gone for a while on a trip I don't worry about not having enough since you only use a little and it lasts a while. I like it so much that I got it for my sister for when she travels for work. There is no strong fragrance. And it reminds me of the tatcha powder cleanser but better priced.

I actually have fallen for this product since starting to use it. I expected it to feel like the microfoliants from Dermalogica, but it turned into a cleanser(expect a gentle chemical exfoliant rather than an abrasive physical one). I have very sensitive(can't even use most salicylic acids or pha/aha/bha-s' without a reaction) combination(on the drier side) acne prone skin. This product was gentle, yet effective on helping reduce all of the issues I face with my skin!! I've started using it about twice a week in rotation with the peach and lily power calm cleanser(I use the powder as a second cleanse when I encorporate it into my routine since I don't typically wear any makeup or sunscreen as ive been reactive to both of those as well) beyond this I love the peach slices snail mucin products like the serum(I don't use this if I exfoliate with this cleanser) and the deep moisture cream. All in all I really am happy that I tried this product as it's not expensive and its been really effective for me so far!!

Im very happy with this product. Its gentle but removes my dead skin doesnt dry me out and makes my makeup go on super smooth. I really like this brand their products are hit or miss though. This product doesnt have fragrance which is great i wish more of their products were fragrance free because they truely do work and the price point is great i hope they take this into consideration
Great face wash! Only thing I use for exfoliation & my skin is flawless < 3

no harsh scrubbing at all, love the gentle non drying lather on contact with water and with light work of fingers my skin looks bright, feels smooth and hydrated after use without the unnecessary stuff a little pricey but you can make it stretch to last a while

I purchased this because I needed a exfoliator, I only use this product 1-2 times a week and it does the job nicely, make sure to put water on your face before use though. Its gentle and gets rid of dead skin without being too harsh on your face. Nice product
love love love this cleanser. ulta please do not ever get rid of it. CHANGED my skin and under 15 dollars. AMAZING.

This was a very interesting product for me to use because I had never used anything like this before. But I was very surprised at how much I liked it! It's pretty easy to use and leaves my skin feeling really soft afterwards. A new exfoliant I really like. Gifted by tony moly.

I received this product complimentary from Tony Moly. This cleanser is so gentle! It comes out as a powder and when you add water to it, it turns into a foam. I really like that it does not dry out my skin or irritate my skin.

Surprisingly gentle for every day cleansing. This brand is new to me and I love the application bottle a lot. Works perfect when double cleansing with an oil or cleansing balm. Complimentary from tonymoly

I'm in love with this cleanser. This is very milky after mixing it with water and exfoliates nicely without stripping off any oils or irritating my skin. I like using this 2-3 times a week for texture free skin. Gifted by TonyMoly.

This cleanser is super easy to use and is gentle on my dry skin. I felt like after one use, my skin felt super clean and not dried out. It removed all of my summer makeup with ease. Will definitely repurchase!! I got this complimentary from tonymoly.

avis.titre: very gently exfoliater makes skin soft and smooth
avis.texte: I received this product complimentary from Tony Moly. I love using rice powders to exfoliate my skin. This one is so nice because it is a very fine powder. I use about a quarter size amount in the palm of my hand, and add a few drops of water to make a thick paste. I then gently rub it all over my face to remove any dead skin cells. This helps to smooth, soften, and brighten my skin. It is very gentle and does not dry out my skin. Makes my skin look and feel baby smooth.

Gifted by Tony Moly Rice Exfoliating Enzyme Cleanser! This has been a unique experience for me, since I have never used this type of cleanser. So this is my first time, trying a powdered Cleanser, which I know it would be good because it's by my favorite company but I was wrong. It's actually excellent . This water-activated powder exfoliant is infused with Rice Powder, Rice Extract & Papaya Enzyme to gently polish the skin removing dead skin

I was gifted by tonymoly this I'm Rice Facial Cleansing Powder. This Powder is so easy to use! Just shake a bit into hand, add water and mix!! I love how soft and smooth my skin feels after using this Powder! It feels do clean and it's glowing!

I am on my combo oily skin. I have a want to build up in my cheese on specifically on my nose and the Exfoliating Portia Contour has been amazing for addressing the extra gunk in that area. Gifted by Tonymoly.

Gifted by TONYMOLY Amazing rice cleanser that does a phenomenal job of exfoliating and polishing my skin without over drying. I especially love how effective it has been in calming down my rosacea after daily use for 2 weeks.
Tiny moly makes a fantastic range of affordable, useful effective and fun skincare products. I've been using them for years and love this for exfoliating my skin. Highly recommend. Gifted By tonymoly

im obsessed, OBSESSED. my skin feels so soft after using this cleanser for the last month. I usually rotate with this rice cleanser and my krave matcha cleanser and its the best combo. I also have used the tatcha one before and honestly feel like i like this better. first off, i really dislike the tacha container because its messy and the powder on the tonymoly one feels finer and lathers really well. HOLY GRAIL.

except that i honestly like this even more!! Not only is it fraction of the cost of tatcha polish, i feel this is less irritating and makes my skin feel so soft and healthy. love love love. my ult holy grail cleanser!!
pretty good, I thought it would be very grainy but if you don't add a lot of water it does exfoliate pretty good and it leaves my skin much clearer after each use!

The bottle says it's gentle enough to use daily, it's not as effective compared to a physical exfoliant and it's drying. I use it everyday only because I'm trying to finish the bottle. I normally put on a serum after so the dryness get resolved but if I skip that, my face feels dry. It also appears that majority of the cleanser is really just cornstarch.
This product is amazing. My skin felt BABY SMOOTH after! My sunscreen and make up applied so nicely after I used this product. Highly recommend.

This is a great dupe for higher end powder to scrub cleansers. I use it every morning and it is not harsh at all. Super gentle and a great way to gently take off my night time skincare to prepare my skin for the day. Theres a reason this won awards!!!
i like this cleanser because its very gentle however it came half full and it smells very odd

I love all TonyMoly products I've tried so far. But the bottles for the rice cleanser are much larger than the amount of cleanser inside. I just bought this yesterday and realized when I got it home that it's only half full. Has it always been this way? Again, I love the product. It's just wild that it's only a half-full container.

I got laser hair removal done and I was advised to use a gentle exfoliating cleanser. This is very gentle on my skin but it exfoliates really well! I am very happy with the product overall. I plan on using this as my daily morning cleanser.

avis.titre: Decent as a cleanser but not a greater exfoliant
avis.texte: The bottle was only a little more than half full. The fragrance isn't great but it isn't very strong. It didn't really exfoliate my skin either

avis.titre: Just don't get it in your eyes
avis.texte: This is a great exfoliator! It's really gentle and let my skin feeling wonderful. But seriously, don't get it in your eyes.

avis.titre: Happy that i choose this over the cheaper alternative
avis.texte: This is great. The exfoliator is not rough, just right for my face. It didn't irritate my face like others. Works well in my at home facial regimen. I'll buy this again if and when i expend this current one.

I love rice products, I wish the beauty industry gave more recognition to rice and similar natural products for skin care. This is a powder in a bottle; instructions say use a quarter-sized amount, but I found that I didn't need that much, probably a dime-sized amount is sufficient. Adjust the amount of suds or creaminess you want with water. Be careful not to get this in your nose, it does have an unusual scent. Works really well and gently.

avis.titre: Unbeatable! Perfect for Rosacea-Acne prone skin types!
avis.texte: Gentle enough to cleanse your skin thoroughly, non-irritating on acne. Perfect combo to battle redness.

This stuff is great it comes out a power and you mix a small amount of water and rub your hands together and it foams up. It's super gentle and it gets the job done. I use this every time I wash my face. After I wash my face this is the next stop. It's gentle and doesn't tear my skin up or, make me red at all. When I run out of it I will definitely be repurchasing it. Best part about it is it doesn't break the bank!!

I've struggled with acne for as long as I can remember and nothing really worked for me. I bought this hoping it would help and so far it has. I sometimes only use it at night depending on how I see my skin but it's been working so far. It's very gentle and I found that either having your hands wet first and then rubbing them together creates a lather for your face that or just have your face wet and then create the lather on your face, but yeah I recommend.

I've seen other people comment on this but I will as well. The container came to me only 50% full, not even 75% as another commenter said. Even if the amount of product is 1.75 grams like it claims, I just feel cheated. I've used a couple of times since I got it and I can't really tell if it's made a difference in my skin but hopefully it will. Either way, when this runs out I will try another brand.

avis.titre: If you struggle with acne GET THIS
avis.texte: This cleanser singlehandedly saved my skin. I've struggled with acne ever since i turned 12 and I'm 22 now. This combined with Cerve sensitive skin lotion has completely cleared my face up. I will be getting this for forever 10/10

Struggling with hyperpigmentation I wanted something cleansing and brighting , does what and good exfoliating will do for my skin without the risk of irritating / inflaming my skin which would make my hyperpigmentation return… don't want that .. and this is *muahhh** chefs kiss so good for an instant brightening and a good clean !!! Would use a balm or pre cleanse makeup off first as this isn't the best for that ! ,,,, don't use this everyday either u will dry out it turns to a FOAMY lather btw so if you have a good water to powder ratio you should have a nice foamy lather. Ok hope this ends up someone else's fav too :D< 3
I'm Rice Active Enzyme Exfoliating Cleanser is my new favorite cleanser. I usually use the Amorepacific one but it's pricey. This one performs pretty well at a reasonable price. Thanks Tonymoly!
I thought I would love the power... but it just feels like powdered soap. Not a strong scent, but also soapy scent. it's a gentle cleanser, but Its definitely not for me

This is great enzyme cleanser. Very gentle and non drying while to effectively cleansing and exfoliating my skin. It's easy to use as well and all around a pleasant experience. I'm enjoying it so far!

Started using this cleaner once a week so I wouldn't break out and it's been good for my skin. It's good for sensitive skin and for those with texture imperfections. I notice it removes dead skin but use a serum afterwards to hydrate.

I really enjoy this product! I keep it on the top shelf of my shower so I don't accidentally get water in it. I sprinkle a little into my palm - about a quarter size - and just add a few drops of water, then rub my hands together until it lathers up. I was pleasantly surprised at just how much lather it can generate!

I love this rice enzyme cleanser. I mix it with a little bit of water and apply to my face. It feels refreshing and makes my skin feel clean and exfoliated. My skin looks and feels softer and more even when used consistently

super soothing! everyone needs a milkfoliant in their life. i like that i get to choose my desired consistency before application, as some days i may need a milkier consistency and others something more textured.

I think this cleanser is so fun to use since it is in a powder form! After mixing it with water, it foams up really well and cleanse the skin perfectly. I also like that it's easy to use, and it something you can use everyday to cleanse!

I used to have a similar product, from a different company, but that product became harsh on my skin, after a while so I decided to give this one a chance. First I would like to see the packaging is very convenient, there is no risk of spillage. I have used it like recommended and I was very happy with the results, my skin was soft nicely exfoliated but gentle enough with my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Unique Powder Cleanser Leaves Skin So Soft
avis.texte: Gifted by TonyMoly I received their I'm Rice Exfoliating Enzyme Cleanser in exchange for my honest review. This product is a powder cleanser that has to be mixed with water. It is recommended to use a quarter sized amount of the powder onto wet hands and add a little water to mix until it is foamy. I can use less product and still have plenty. It is so easy to mix up and it feels silky and wonderful on my facial skin. It is nice that you are not paying for water. The bottle was only about half full and I'm sure the product settled over time, but it would be nice if TonyMoly could use even less packaging which is more environmentally friendly. This is a gentle exfoliator that is safe for daily use. Key ingredients include: Rice Powder and Papaya Enzymes to gently cleanse and exfoliate skin, Rice Extract which is anti-inflammatory and it soothes and hydrates skin, and Corn Starch which cleanses impurities and replenishes moisture. I love that the product is fragrance free. It has a low pH and is free from artificial colors, sulfates, parabens, alcohol and gluten as well. It is vegan. It is a great product for airline travel as it is not a liquid. It makes my skin feel soft and radiant. It left my skin feeling moisturized and not dried out or stripped at all. I enjoy using it daily.

This is my first time using this brand and I love it! The cleanser is gentle and feels like it does exfoliate the skin. My skin's moisture barrier does not feel stripped after using this and looks a lot brighter too.

This is my first Tony Molly product I've used, and I'm so impressed! I have somewhat sensitive skin, so I'm always looking for products that are gentle exfoliants. The I'm Rice Enzyme Powder Cleanser is super easy to use by dispensing a little in my hand, adding some warm water, and massaging my face for 15 seconds or so. It gently bubbles and becomes very smooth feeling on the skin, and it washes off very easily. Since using this, I've noticed my skin looks brighter and the texture is softer. Overall, this gets an A+ in my book!

I'm new to Tony Moly as well as to powder cleansers so I was quite surprised when just a little bit of the powder added to water turned into a gentle face cleanser. This is great for sensitive skin and would travel very easily. For the price and natural ingredients I would definitely incorporate it into my routine.

I was gifted by Tonymoly in exchange for my honest review. It's similar to the dermalogica daily exfoliator, it works with water and creates a fun foam. Its not too abrasive so I don't have to worry about damaging my skin. I notice my skin feeling soft and looking healthier

Complimentary from Tony Moly but all thoughts are my own This Rice Enzyme Powder Cleanser is so nice! It's always fun mixing your own skincare products and this one is no exception! I like that a little bit of product creates such a nice lather as soon as you add water and it leaves my skin nicely cleansed and smooth.

This is such a fantastic product at SUCH a great price point! This is a cleanser in the same category as Tatcha's rice cleanser, Dermalogica daily exfoliant, Amorepacific enzyme cleanser, etc (yes - the word "dupes" is fitting). Which means it is a powder that you add water to in order to create the texture you desire. Add a little water for a more abrasive feel, add more for a rich lather! The ingredients list are simple and short, with no added fragrance. The reason this provides exfoliation is via the enzymatic action of papaya. This offers a gentle and natural chemical exfoliation, which will lead to brighter skin with consistent use. Incredible value and such a great product! Received complimentary from the brand.

This rice face wash is so nice! It's a very gentle exfoliating scrub that turns into a soapy consistency. It's very gentle on my sensitive skin! I like that you can use it everyday and that it doesn't contain any fragrances!

This product is SO interesting! I've used powder cleansers one before- and this one is lovely. Dump a little into the hand or cleansing brush, a little water and it just frothes right up! Smells amazing, makes the skin feel clean without being stripped- I adore TonyMoly products! This is a great one, especially for the price point!

Really impressed with this cleanser! I know this brand and have high hopes on it! After receiving the product and after used I notice this is a very lightweight cleanser , it balances my oil from my face out , the rice also has Brighting effect just you have to use longer

I have never used a powder face wash but I am so impressed with this. Not only is the formula great, but this is such a great product to take when traveling. It makes things so convenient. I also really like the formula and the results I have gotten so far.

Gifted by the brand. Such an interesting product! I'm not into scrubs or harsh face washes because they are just too much for my sensitive skin, so I was worried about trying this cleanser. To my surprise, it's quite gentle and non-abrasive on the skin. It's a powder that you mix in with water in your hand and then wash your face with the mixture. My face felt clean but not stripped.

It is gifted from TonyMoly for my review. I love this powder cleanser! It becomes foamy very easily and gets the job done. My skin does not feel dry at all afterward and it's a great morning cleanser for me

I really like this cleanser! I love how it's a powder because as someone who travels a lot it's much easier to use. I have sensitive skin and it seem to have worked well so far. I look forward to seeing what results I have after a few weeks.
Recently got. Recently found out my skin is sensitive. Love this product. New Skin Era for Me.

avis.titre: Finally a cleanser for my skin
avis.texte: I've been trying so hard to find a cleanser to match my sensitive combination skin and this is it. No more over cleansed dry or oily stuffy skin. I bought a marshmallow cleanser whip maker to go along with it and just a little goes a long way. I also noticed so much of my redness has disappeared too. I hope they never run out of stock of this.

I've had this product for a couple of months and I like it. I don't know if I love it. Depending on what skin is going through sometimes it's too gentle. It doesn't really have a scent, similar to maybe an unscented dove. It did help balance my oily skin and clean the blackheads from my t-zone.
I absolutely love this! I use it in a dual cleanse set up. I start with The ordinary squalane cleanser, follow up with the I'm rice exfoliating cleanser, then moisturize. It's like a dream!
This cleanser was not exfoliating enough for me but it did lather wonderfully and leave my skin feeling clean and soft but not stripped. It would make a great cleanser for a sensitive skin type.

I love this brand and even the other I'm Rice products, but the smell on this is too much for me to get past. Another review mentioned that it smelled like baby spit up and that is exactly what I thought too. My skin feels okay, but I can probably achieve similar results through a different cleanser and using the I'm Rice mask as an occasional follow up.

Reminds me of dermologica exfoliant, except foams up. I'd recommend not to go past the 15 second recommendation, i think the papaya in it is making my face itch. But I'll give it time and come back with an update
I was looking for a new exfoliating product and this one really exfoliate. My skin looks brighter and feels soft.

I purchased this on a whim a few months ago, and I love it. I have combination skin that leans more oily, and it's sensitive. I use this a few times a week. The bottle tells you to use a quarter-size amount. You don't need that much! I get away with about a dime's worth. Also, I saw a few reviews stating the product is clumpy. You've got to emulsify it with a little water. Personally, while the product is okay by itself, I have found it works in tandem with a good hydrating cleanser (like Cerave's Cream-to-Foam Cleanser). This combination makes my skin glowy and radiant. I've gotten compliments, and that's something considering I suffer from large pores and adult acne.

I wanted so bad to love this and I just can't. It made me breakout SO BAD, and after two months, I'm still fixing it. it made my face tight (I have oily skin so it stripped my skin horribly), and it smells so strong of old bar soap that it made me gag. :(
My sensitive skin loves this. I've been wanting to try an affordable powder cleanser. Smells like bar soap which isn't bad. Doesn't have the exfoliating sensation like normal ones do tho.
This is probably the first tonymoly product I haven't loved. It works great and makes my skin feel so good but it smells like baby spit up mixed with cheap bar soap.
Gently exfoliates and a little goes a long way. Definitely comparable to the higher priced micro exfoliant. Love it!

I wanted a microexfoliant dupe similar to the dermalogica one. This isn't quite as gritty as the dermalogica one and does foam up a bit more but I leave it on for a minute (or a few if I'm in the bath) and it gives a nice gentle glow and feels good
